reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Sebum & Blackhead Cleansing Oil 200ml
reviews.text: I wanted to add an oil based cleanser to my routine to double cleanse, I tried this one since I trust SOMEBYMI products. It was a great addition specially during this winter months that I worry about dry irritated skin. I can comfortably make sure I’ve washed my face without getting the feeling I completely stripped my skin.
reviews.zh: 我想加入一支油性潔面嚟做雙重清潔，因為信任 SOMEBYMI 嘅產品所以試咗呢枝。佢係一個好好嘅補充，特別係喺依家冬天，我會擔心皮膚乾燥敏感。我可以安心確認洗完塊面，又唔會有完全將皮膚保護層洗走嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Sebum & Blackhead Cleansing Oil 200ml
reviews.text: You have to shake the cleanser before using so that it will suspend. I haven't tried it long enough to know how its effects are yet but it seems promising.
reviews.zh: 使用前要搖勻枝潔面產品，等佢均勻混合。我用嘅時間仲唔夠長，所以暫時仲未知效果點，但睇落幾有潛力。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Sebum & Blackhead Cleansing Oil 200ml
reviews.text: Not the best for removing heavy eye makeup and it will sting a little bit if it does get in your eye. Removes sunscreen and face makeup well tho. I think it does help with my blackheads, but I wish it did a little bit more for them
reviews.zh: 對於卸除厚重眼妝就唔算最好，唔小心入到眼會有少少刺痛。防曬同面部彩妝就卸得幾好。我覺得佢對我嘅黑頭有少少幫助，但就希望可以再多啲效果。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Sebum & Blackhead Cleansing Oil 200ml
reviews.text: Eu adorei esse sabonete em óleo, tem uma textura maravilhosa, um aroma bem delicado e faz uma ótima limpeza na pele. Adorei
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支油狀潔面乳，質地超正，香氣好細緻，而且清潔皮膚嘅效果超讚。好鍾意。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Sebum & Blackhead Cleansing Oil 200ml
reviews.text:
שמן הידרופילי טוב מאוד

מנקה איפור טוב
מתאים

reviews.zh: 非常好用嘅卸妝油，清潔力強、唔會抽乾皮膚水分，畀人清爽嘅感覺，建議用完之後再用洗面奶清洗。卸妝效果唔錯，我覺得適合所有膚質。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Sebum & Blackhead Cleansing Oil 200ml
reviews.text: Not the best cleansing oil I’ve tried but is is definitely a really good one. A little bit thinner than I prefer. Otherwise it spreads easily and cleanses very well, nice scent that isn’t too much.
reviews.zh: 唔算我用過嘅卸妝油入面最好嘅一支，但絕對係好好用嘅一支。比我想像中稀少少，但除咗呢點之外，佢容易推開而且清潔力好好，氣味唔會太濃恰到好處。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Sebum & Blackhead Cleansing Oil 200ml
reviews.text: It’s really nice but it doesn’t feel like it cleans properly to get rid of blackheads but it’s very moisturising
reviews.zh: 佢真係幾好用，但感覺上對付黑頭就清潔得唔夠徹底，不過佢非常保濕。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Lacto Soy Sebum & Blackhead Cleansing Oil 200ml
reviews.text: I’ve used better cleansing oils. This one is ok. It has a funky smell at first but I’m not sure if it’s ok to use to remove eye makeup it kinda irritates my eyes..
reviews.zh: 我用過更好嘅卸妝油。呢支都OK。頭先有陣怪味，但我就唔知佢適唔適合用嚟卸眼妝，因為用落有少少刺激到對眼……
